tonight.headline: Down 11 with Allen and Allgeier still to play — ESPN still makes you a 75% favourite
body: Bad news first: the early games have been slow for you — Warren 2.2 with Dowdle back and taking carries, Wilson 2.5 on two targets, Kamara 0.2 on the bench — and Bok-aneers' Trevor Lawrence threw four touchdowns in London for 27.3. London did pay you back: Tuten 24.7 (a touchdown and two touchdown catches) and Fairbairn's last-second winner, 10.

Nothing to change. Allen (14:25) and Allgeier (14:05) are your unplayed starters, worth 37.8 projected; ESPN projects 136.8 to 108.8. One check: Arizona's inactive list at 12:35 — if Allgeier is on it, move McLaurin into the flex. Nothing in the reporting says you will need to.

case.label: Why leave it
case.body: Arizona named Allgeier the starter with Jeremiyah Love out (AZCardinals.com 16 Oct); Allen is off Buffalo's final report (SI 17 Oct). The flex is a 12.4 tie — no thesis, no swap.

case.label: What can still go wrong
case.body: Bok-aneers still have Tucker Kraft and MarShawn Lloyd on Sunday night. Your Monday option, McLaurin, stays on the bench unless Allgeier is scratched.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Allgeier inactive at 12:35 CDMX: McLaurin into the flex. Otherwise nothing.
